people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.
translations.bsb: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Joseph’s house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.
translations.kjv: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
translations.asv: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; and he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
